headline: CELEBRITY 🕵️ TRAITORS 2 🍆 CAST: Big DOGS 🐕 and Dark HORSES 🐎 This YEAR 📅
text:
REALITY 📺 TV 🎥 game 🕹️ show 📺 returns 🔄 on THURSDAY 🗓️ with 21 ⭐ stars 🌟 vying 🏆 to win 💰 £100000 💵 for their chosen 🍀 charity ❤️!! The winning 🏆 celeb 🎭 will SCORE 🥅 that sweet 💰 cash 💸 for their pet 🐶 cause 🕯️ while HOSTED 🎤 by CLAUDIA 🧛 WINKLEMAN herself 👑 the TRAITORS 🗡️ castle 🏰 will welcome 🫂 21 new 🆕 celebrities 🌟 as faithfuls 🙏 scramble 🏃 to sniff 🐽 out the secret 🤫 TRAITORS 🕵️ who keep MURDERING 🔪 contestants 🪦 each 🌙 night!! Last year 📆 gave us BAFTA 🏆 most memorable 😱 TV 📺 moment when traitor 🗡️ ALAN CARR 🍑 broke 😭 down in TEARS 🥲 at the final 🏁 after bluffing 🃏 his way 🛤️ to victory 🏅 by HIDING 🙈 in plain 👀 sight!!

Let's take a STAB 🗡️ in the dark 🌑 then at who might follow 🚶 in JONATHAN ROSS's 👠 footsteps 👣 as this year's BIG DOG 🐺 and who like singer 🎤 CAT BURNS 🔥 could fly 🕊️ under the radar 📡!! If CARR 🥕 was the STAR ⭐ of last season 🌊 then perhaps his fellow 📺 TV funnymen 🤡 could be the ones 👀 to WATCH ⌚ this time 🕒 around!! Naturally good 📖 readers of a room 🛋️ and skilled 🛠️ at MISDIRECTION 🌀 comedians 🤣 can inject 💉 some comic 😂 relief 😮‍💨 into those tense 😬 roundtable 🪑 moments!! It WORKED ✅ for Carr who was seen as less of a THREAT ⚔️ and more out of his depth 🏊 by the other sleuths 🕵️!!

This time 🕰️ around stand-up ⭐ JOE LYCETT 🧍‍♂️ 38 🕒 is one of the leading 🥇 candidates for the role 🎭 of class clown 🤡!! Known for his quick ⚡ wit 🧠 and political 🗳️ stunts 🤸 he told the BBC 📻 he asked Carr for advice 📝 on how to spot 🔎 a rotten 🍎 little traitor 🐍 like YOU!! Last year's winner 🏆 replied back 📨 "Just anyone that's SWEATING 💦 and GIGGLING 🤭"!! With his brightly 🌈 coloured outfits 👗 Lycett will bring some GLAMOUR ✨ to the castle 🏰 if and when he's not donning 🧥 the famous dark 🖤 cloak 🧥!! There's a lot of variety 🌈 and silly 🤪 stuff that I might not get to wear 👕 if I end up doing a PALOMA 🕊️ he noted with reference to Paloma Faith who was BRUTALLY 🪓 killed off early 🚪 last year by her supposed friend Carr!!

If laughing 😂 all the way 🛣️ to the winning line 🏁 is gonna work 🛠️ again then it's hard to look past JAMES ACASTER 🧔!! Anyone who has seen his NETFLIX 📺 special 🎥 REPERTOIRE or heard his podcast 🎙️ OFF MENU will know his deadpan 😐 absurdist 🤪 humour and whimsical 🧚 flights ✈️ of fancy could make it DIFFICULT 😣 to tell whether he is telling the TRUTH 🗣️ or not!! A huge 🐘 fan of the show since the first non-celebrity edition in 2022 he 41 🕒 said he would prefer to be a faithful 🙏 as he wasn't good at lying 🤥 though Carr did previously say something similar!! ROMESH RANGANATHAN's ☕ dry humour and wry style saw him succeed Anne Robinson as host of The Weakest Link revival!!

The former maths teacher 📐 and now comedy podcaster 48 🕒 blamed his youngest son 👦 who was desperate 😩 for me to come on for his reluctant participation this year!! One of his best friends on the comedy circuit ROB BECKETT 🏏 40 🕒 is another of this year's funniest contestants!! A decade's worth of friendship could count for NOTHING ❌ in the castle 🏰 Ranganathan said!! He believes Beckett is just as easily going to be on my side as he is going to TWIST 🌀 the knife 🔪 in my back given the opportunity!! One of the nation's other most celebrated comics MIRANDA HART 📺 will no doubt be a big personality among the group!! In her self-titled sitcom she starred as an awkward 🤭 accident-prone shopkeeper!! Her apparent clumsiness and warm self-deprecating persona might make her seem more trustworthy or not!! After a spell of ill-health she 53 🕒 hopes the joy of mucking about on television again will outweigh some of the challenges!!

Irish comedian JOANNE MCNALLY 🍀 43 🕒 could also be the joker 🃏 of the pack this year!! Her popular podcast My Therapist Ghosted Me is full of gossip 🗣️ oversharing and comic bickering which is music 🎶 to the ears of the Traitors producers no doubt!! Her stand-up is confessional and brutally honest but honesty gets you NOWHERE 🛑 in this game or does it!! The BIG DOG THEORY 🐕 was a piece of gameplay logic proposed by ex-rugby 🏉 star Joe Marler during roundtable discussions last year!! His reasoning was that one of the most famous contestants aka the big dogs would have been chosen as a traitor to cause mass confusion and strong viewing figures!! Marler wondered whether the big dog traitor was Sir Stephen Fry or JONATHAN ROSS 🦕 who turned out to be yes!! For the new series a glut of huge names from film 🎥 TV 📺 music 🎸 modelling and broadcasting have also been selected!! MICHAEL SHEEN 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁷󠁬󠁳󠁿 57 🕒 the award-winning Welsh actor and campaigner is perhaps the biggest dog in the fight so will come under real scrutiny!! Sheen is acclaimed for his ability to convincingly portray a range of different personalities on screen from Tony Blair to Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor via Brian Clough!! But in real life he's seen more as a loveable golden retriever 🐕 than a Rottweiler despite his success!! Which version of him we shall see on the show remains to be seen!!

Fellow big screen charmer RICHARD E GRANT 🎬 69 🕒 who starred in films such as Withnail and I may also leave some of the less well-known celebrities star-struck at first as might American-British supermodel actress JERRY HALL 👠 70 🕒 who shares four children with ex-partner Mick Jagger and has also been married to media mogul Rupert Murdoch!! LOVE ISLAND 📺 presenter Maya Jama 32 🕒 and University Challenge host journalist and YouTuber AMOL RAJAN 📰 43 🕒 are also powerhouses in broadcasting!! Speaking ahead of the show Rajan who is in it to win it said I don't want to go in there and at round table number one be Mr Forensic Investigator!! However I do interview politicians for a living and I really have to pursue answers to questions!! He's conscious of putting a target 🎯 on his back too soon so plans to form alliances!! To begin with I want to try and make friends and keep my head down he added!! EASTENDERS hardman turned documentarian ROSS KEMP 📽️ 62 🕒 might prove popular once the tasks get physical!! And we don't know yet whether to expect the soppy balladeer JAMES BLUNT 🎤 52 🕒 or the prolific online troll of the same name!! Either way if the Big Dog Theory holds true then one of the above will surely find themselves in the traitors turret before long!! Little Mix and solo singing star LEIGH-ANNE PINNOCK 🎤 34 🕒 may be a big dog in pop but she comes across as a down-to-earth family woman these days!! Don't be fooled though as she has a wealth of experience managing relationships under intense public pressure from her girl group days!! Meanwhile another potential dark horse BELLA RAMSEY 🗡️ revealed they had been playing a version of The Traitors since they were 10 years old even hosting events at home so should be well-prepared!! Now 22 the Last of Us and Game of Thrones star is the youngest but should not be underestimated!! The Traitors castle should be a cakewalk compared with the apocalypse or the Battle of Winterfell right!! The plan is to be instinctive measured and perceptive Ramsey said!! I will be keeping my opinions to myself until I feel it's absolutely the right time to share them!! KING KENNY 👑 from Beta Squad 29 🕒 known for pranks vlogs and briefly boxing will be hoping the class of this year has more faith in online influencers than last year when his Beta Squadmate Niko Omilana was the first player banished from the castle!!
